title: Factorization of a Boolean coordinate sum
statement:
Let $\iota$ be a finite set and let $H_i:\{0,1\}\times\{0,1\}\to\mathbb C$ be arbitrary for each $i\in\iota$. Then the sum over all pairs of Boolean vectors of the product of their coordinate contributions factors as
\[\sum_{x,y\in\{0,1\}^{\iota}}\prod_{i\in\iota}H_i(x_i,y_i)=\prod_{i\in\iota}\sum_{b,c\in\{0,1\}}H_i(b,c).\]
hypotheses_covered: For each $i\in\iota$, $H_i$ is a function from $\{0,1\}^2$ to $\mathbb C$
